Hi all — I reviewed the Medivex redline and made a focused set of changes. High-level:

- Acceptable: most operational clauses are fine (invoice flow, PO format, delivery).
- Flags: two legal items will need attention before we sign — liability cap language and the Net 60 payment term.

Summary of edits (see attached "Medivex_MSA_Redlines_v2.docx"):
1) Liability cap: proposed to tie to the most recent 12-months fees rather than a fixed dollar figure. This gives both sides clearer exposure alignment.
2) Payment term: we propose Net 60 for first deployment only if Medivex agrees to a 5% prepayment holdback until PO-ACKs and billing cadence are verified. Alternative is Net 45 with no holdback.
3) Data residency clause: minor wording tweak to allow regional processing with contractual assurances (no change to our standard offering).

Operational asks for procurement/ops to unblock portal registration:
- Confirm billing contact and remit address that will appear in Ariba.
- Provide SOC2 Type II report link (or test report) and contact for security questionnaire (if available).
- Confirm preferred PO acknowledgement method (SFTP drop + webhook preferred).

If Medivex accepts the liability wording and either the Net 45 or the holdback option, we can proceed to signature and provisioning.

Kimberly Park
Counsel, Redwood Inference
attachments: Medivex_MSA_Redlines_v2.docx
